platformSurfaces.collector: Service health: restricted Windows supervisor/service-status export
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getApiEvidence` adapter; service state, uptime and restart counts for exact API instance/release
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing export UNKNOWN; measured stopped is unavailable fact. Current ApiHealthEvidence has no service/restart fields; extension needed; supervisor D02 OPEN

platformSurfaces.collector: Process monitoring: process-lifecycle/heartbeat export, without command-line/env capture
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getWorkerEvidence`; supervisor process generation plus durable worker heartbeat
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing collector UNKNOWN; observed offline/crash loop UNAVAILABLE; PID alone proves no useful work. Process-generation binding needed

platformSurfaces.collector: CPU/memory/disk advisory samples via read-only OS counters, NatForgeAI attribution
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: New advisory fields feeding api/workers; OS sample interval, units, host/process label and sample completeness
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing counters UNKNOWN; no zero substitution. Thresholds and overhead budget D09 OPEN; host data admin-only, do not attribute Zuto usage to a tenant

platformSurfaces.collector: API availability/latency/error rate: redacted request metrics and later approved loopback probe
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: API exports; MON reads safe view
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getApiEvidence`; request observations, route-class counts, p50 latency/error percentage over explicit window
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: No observations UNKNOWN, not 100% uptime. HTTP 200/liveness alone is not readiness; probe never starts app/jobs. Route classes/rate window and probes OPEN

platformSurfaces.collector: IIS pool/request queue: site/pool-scoped status/counters, sanitized request-class metrics
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getApiEvidence` extension; IIS/supervisor status for exact pool/binding
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing permission/interface UNKNOWN; observed failed pool/queue problem visible. No IIS config/service-control grant; extension not present

platformSurfaces.collector: Worker health: BullMQ registry + application heartbeat/lease summary
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: WRK exports safe facts; MON reads
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getWorkerEvidence`; queue registry and durable heartbeat, lease/stuck/crash/retry/dead-letter/version evidence
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Unknown/unavailable export UNKNOWN; stale heartbeat DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE per E-MODEL. A03 embedded/standalone ownership unresolved; no collector starts workers

platformSurfaces.collector: Scheduler status: per-job status and singleton/lease heartbeat export
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getSchedulerEvidence`; authoritative scheduler owner, last heartbeat and job state
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing collector UNKNOWN; observed stopped UNAVAILABLE, stale DEGRADED. Existing in-process status is not evidence it is bound or single-owner in production

platformSurfaces.collector: DB health: application pool metrics plus scoped database observation view
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: API/pool instrumentation emits; MON redacted view, no DB admin/runtime URL
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getDatabaseEvidence`; connectivity, saturation, p50 latency, deadlocks, transaction/CAS/replay counts, X-approved schema version
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: No telemetry UNKNOWN; observed failed connection UNAVAILABLE. Schema unknown explicitly degrades; collector must not migrate or “repair” schema

platformSurfaces.collector: Redis/queue health: restricted queue aggregate exporter
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: Queue producer exports; MON via F-approved infrastructure interface only
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getQueueEvidence` extension; queue depth, consumer lag, Redis health/availability source
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Absent UNKNOWN; waitingCount alone does not prove Redis uptime. Lag/connectivity fields and Redis ACL/credential source unresolved; never reuse broad runtime credentials

platformSurfaces.collector: Certificate expiry: read public certificate metadata for exact NatForgeAI binding and renewal status export
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: MON public metadata only; certificate admin owns renewal
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: New evidence/dimension, not currently declared in E model; leaf/chain validity, expiry UTC, binding identity and renewal result
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing/invalid time UNKNOWN; within approved expiry window at least DEGRADED; expired certificate availability failure recorded. No private-key/PFX read or renewal command

platformSurfaces.collector: Disk capacity: volume free bytes/percentage plus release/shared/scratch/spool volume mapping
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: MON minimum counter access, no media/backup content
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: New capacity field; OS volume counter. M03 host advisory sample reused with same identity, not counted twice
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing volume mapping/counter UNKNOWN; approved thresholds DEGRADED/AT_RISK. Capacity/permissions are separate; no deletion/retention action by collector

platformSurfaces.collector: Backup state: independent redacted G facts export and ingest heartbeat
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: BKP writes facts; MON reads safe export only
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getBackupEvidence`; G owns last success, age, verification, offsite ack/immutability, restore rehearsal, retention
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing signal UNKNOWN and silence alert; failed verification/backup preserved. No raw backup-run.json wholesale ingestion: redact database names/paths and unnecessary metadata. E/G threshold and Windows adapter reconciliation OPEN

platformSurfaces.collector: Provider health: aggregate sanitized adapter/callback metrics
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: Authorized provider adapter emits; MON no provider credential
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `getProviderEvidence`; latency/status class/timeouts/auth failures, callback/reconciliation delay. Callback evidence via `getCallbackEvidence` where supported
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Absent UNKNOWN, never AVAILABLE; failure does not switch account/provider or initiate a test provider call. Exact per-provider binding/export unresolved

platformSurfaces.collector: Alert delivery: external bounded outbox/notification adapter with delivery receipts and own heartbeat
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: E-INGEST produces approved alert projection; NOTIFY sends safe payload only
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: Outbound `operational_alerts` projection plus durable receipt/attempt facts; channel receiver acknowledgement is delivery truth
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Failure emits platform diagnostic UNKNOWN event; undelivered is not acknowledged/resolved. Adapter, event-type mapping, independent fallback, routes and credentials OPEN

platformSurfaces.collector: Log retention: protected redacted log sink plus retention/ingest completeness exporter
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: Producers append; MON safe read; human policy administrator controls retention
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: Platform retention evidence; E event MySQL store distinct from supervisor/IIS/app logs; protected audit separate
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing exporter/sink UNKNOWN; spool/storage failure explicit; retention cannot delete event evidence via dedup. Policy/periods, access, expiry and legal holds OPEN

platformSurfaces.collector: Incident correlation: E correlation/dedup projection and scoped transport checks
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: E-INGEST trusted server; MON read; authorized human for lifecycle
platformSurfaces.interfaceAndTruth: `correlationId`, `evt1:`, `inc1:`, `alt1:`, `hlt1:` and durable E rows; audit facts for material transitions
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing/mismatched/replayed conflicts visible, never mint random anchors. Scope key isolation/end-to-end delivery correlation need proof; correlation is not authority

platformSurfaces.collector: Release/version identity: publisher-signed manifest and supervisor-resolved launch identity
platformSurfaces.permittedIdentity: Trusted publisher injects; MON reads safe manifest/process association
platformSurfaces.failureAndGap: Missing => null/UNKNOWN. Empty/forged/mismatched identity rejected as unknown/drift by proposed adapter; current E resolver only null-coalesces. Version match alone cannot imply process health
